Inspector is a four-mode contextual tool (Insert, Format, Style, Info), not a generic properties column. Settings uses a separate information architecture. Compact and mobile breakpoints are inferred only from observed collapse of sidebar/inspector; no phone or tablet screenshot exists. Document contents, marketing illustrations, style-preset photography, and pricing art are content, not chrome.
